settings.heading: Idukki Green Cardamom
settings.lede: Bought by aroma, graded by sieve, and sold whole — because the pod is the only packaging that actually keeps.

settings.label: The region
settings.heading: We went up until the air turned cold.
settings.text:
Cardamom grows here between roughly 900 and 1,400 metres, under shade, on the western slopes of the Ghats. Harvest runs October to February and the pods are picked green, several passes to a plant, because they do not ripen together.

We buy at the estate, open a pod before agreeing a price, and pack whole.
settings.footnote: Figures describe the growing region, not a single farm.

settings.title: 6 mm
settings.use: Everyday chai and stocks. Crushed, indistinguishable from bold.

settings.title: 7 mm
settings.use: The workhorse. Enough presence to serve whole, priced to use freely.

settings.title: 8 mm+
settings.use: Biryani, pulao, gifting — anywhere the pod is seen on the plate.

settings.label: Biryani & pulao
settings.why: Whole pods go into the pot whole and arrive on the plate whole, so size is the one thing a guest actually sees. This is the grade worth paying up for.

settings.label: Chai & coffee
settings.why: The pod gets crushed into the pan, so appearance buys you nothing. Same hills, same cure, roughly a third less — spend the difference on buying more often.

settings.label: Desserts & baking
settings.why: You want seed, not husk. 7 mm gives a full seed core without the premium for a showy pod, and grinds down clean.

settings.label: A gift
settings.why: The only occasion where buying for the eye is the correct call. Big pods, tin sealed, harvest and fill dates printed on the label.

settings.claim: We buy by nose, not by size.
settings.body: A sieve sorts pods by width. It says nothing about how much volatile oil is inside. We open a pod before we agree a price.

settings.claim: A grade is a measurement, not a verdict.
settings.body: 8 mm pods cost more because they look impressive whole. For anything you crush, a 7 mm pod is frequently the better buy — and we'll say so.

settings.claim: Whole pods only. The pod is the packaging.
settings.body: Ground cardamom begins losing aroma the moment it is ground. The husk is a sealed container evolved for exactly this job. We don't improve on it.
